context.stack_assumption: Infer from existing codebase (React/Next.js or similar frontend, Node.js/Express or similar backend, existing DB such as MongoDB/PostgreSQL/Firebase)

implementation_tasks.description: Display all messages and contact form submissions sent by users to the admin inside the admin dashboard.
requirements: Create a dedicated 'Messages' section/tab in the admin dashboard
Fetch and list all user-submitted messages (from contact form or chat) stored in the database
Each message entry must show: sender name, sender email, message body, timestamp, and read/unread status
Mark messages as read when admin opens/views them
Support search and filter by user, date range, and read/unread status
Show message count badge on the sidebar nav item
implementation_tasks.database: Add a 'messages' collection/table with fields: id, userId, senderName, senderEmail, subject, body, timestamp, isRead, repliedAt

implementation_tasks.description: Admins can view full analytics broken down per user who has visited the site, with export to Excel.
requirements: Track and store per-user analytics: userId, name, email, firstVisit, lastVisit, totalVisits, pagesViewed, matchesWatched, planType, country/IP
Display an analytics table in the admin dashboard with one row per user
Columns: User Name, Email, Plan, First Visit, Last Visit, Total Visits, Pages Viewed, Matches Watched, Country
Support sorting by any column and filtering by date range or plan type
Add an 'Export to Excel' button that downloads the full analytics table as a .xlsx file using a library such as SheetJS (xlsx) or exceljs
Include a summary row at the top with totals and averages
Show a per-user detail view (modal or page) with a chart of their visit history over time
library_suggestions: chart.js or recharts for visit history chart

implementation_tasks.description: Real-time or near-real-time notifications to the admin when a user sends a message or email.
requirements: Show a notification bell icon in the admin dashboard header with an unread count badge
When a user submits a contact form or sends a chat message, trigger a notification to the admin
Notification payload must include: type (message | email), senderName, preview of the message, timestamp
Implement using WebSockets (Socket.io preferred) OR polling every 30 seconds as a fallback
Clicking a notification should navigate the admin directly to that message in the inbox
Store notifications in the database with fields: id, type, messageId, isRead, createdAt
Admin can mark individual notifications or all as read
Optionally: send admin an email alert (to admin email) for each new incoming message using the existing email service

implementation_tasks.description: Allow the admin to reply to user messages or emails directly from the dashboard, with replies delivered to the user's inbox.
requirements: In the Messages section, add a 'Reply' button/panel for each message
Admin can compose a reply with a subject and body in a rich text or plain textarea
On submit, the reply must be sent as a real email to the user's registered email address using the existing email/SMTP service (e.g. Nodemailer, SendGrid, Mailgun)
Store the reply in the database linked to the original message: fields: id, originalMessageId, adminReply, repliedAt
Update the original message record with repliedAt timestamp and a 'replied' status badge in the UI
Show reply thread history under each message (original message + admin reply)
Prevent duplicate replies by disabling the reply button after a reply is sent (allow re-reply with a 'Send another reply' option)

email_requirements.from: Admin email address (configured in environment variables)
email_requirements.subject: Re: [original subject] or custom subject
email_requirements.footer: Include platform branding and a 'Do not reply to this automated message' disclaimer if reply-to is not set

ui_ux_requirements: All new sections must follow the existing admin dashboard design system (colors, fonts, component styles)
Messages inbox must have a split-pane layout: list on the left, message detail + reply on the right
Unread messages should be visually distinct (bold text, colored dot indicator)
Analytics table must support pagination (25 rows per page default)
Export button should show a loading spinner while generating the Excel file
Notifications dropdown must be accessible from any admin page without full page reload
All new components must be mobile-responsive

api_endpoints_to_create.description: Fetch all user messages with pagination and filters
Fetch a single message by ID and mark it as read
Send a reply email to the user and store it in DB
Fetch per-user analytics data with sort/filter support
Export analytics data as .xlsx file download

environment_variables_needed: ADMIN_EMAIL — the admin's email address for sending reply emails
SMTP_HOST / SMTP_PORT / SMTP_USER / SMTP_PASS — or existing email service credentials
SOCKET_IO_ENABLED — boolean to toggle WebSocket notifications vs polling
implementation_order: 2. Backend API endpoints for messages CRUD and reply with email send
3. Backend API endpoints for per-user analytics and Excel export
4. WebSocket or polling setup for real-time admin notifications
5. Frontend: Admin Messages Inbox UI with reply panel
6. Frontend: Admin Analytics table with sort, filter, pagination, and export button
7. Frontend: Notification bell with dropdown in admin header
8. End-to-end testing: send message as user → appears in admin inbox → admin replies → email arrives in user inbox
testing_checklist: User submits contact form → message appears in admin Messages tab
Admin opens message → status changes to 'read'
Admin receives bell notification when new message arrives
Admin clicks notification → navigates to the correct message
Admin replies → user receives email in their inbox with correct content
Analytics table shows correct data per user
Export to Excel downloads a valid .xlsx file with all user rows
All UI is responsive on mobile screen sizes
